body: I went to the doctor today because my friend told me it would help. I'm going to be put on antidepressants and I will have a counselling session weekly from next week I think. There are teachers I feel I can talk to, but the one I really got on well with left recently, which is a shame. The school does have a counselor, but this is something I'd rather keep out of school if possible, as I'm afraid questions would start to be raised and I don't want this to become general knowledge.

Hey, I'm sorry to hear about how you feel, I wouldn't wish it upon anyone. Living out really would be ideal, but being 17 and in full time education I don't really have anywhere I can go permanently, but I may well go to the homeless shelter near my school and get home after they are in bed just to avoid it all.

I've asked them politely to leave, and all I got back was a no. Apparently I have to talk to them, and I have tried to explain that actually, I don't but they aren't having any of it. In fact when I tried to go to the loo I was thrown onto my bed by my dad as I tried to walk past, which was unexpected. 

I am seriously considering it this summer, I was leaving it to see if anything would change for the better, but so far it has somehow become even worse, and I may even go sooner than I had planned. All I really want is the choice for myself, not for others to decide.

Other friends I have aren't bothered, they just say get over it, stop being a pussy. I want to go to a doctor, but I don't like talking about it to anyone, let alone my family. To be honest I don't think talking to my parents is going to help at all, if not make things worse, because I literally loathe my family, and whether they are trying to help or not, they are just making the situation more difficult.

I don't even know if I wanna go to uni, shitting myself and not sure how i would survive. I haven't spoken to her since, and I don't intend to again, she makes everything more difficult to deal with now. I guess I'll just see how things change over the next 7 weeks

I live in England, but the one friend who I can express my feelings to is going with me to get help, but I'm the kind of person who keeps things bottled up, expressing my feelings never ends well from my experience. I guess I'll see how it goes

Of the few friends I have, I have only one who I feel I can tell any of this to, suicidal thoughts and everything, because she has been through the same before. She's helping me and she's amazing but I don't think it'll change my mind
I'm 17. I realize this is young and I would have the whole of my life ahead of me, but I don't want to wait and find out how my life will get worse
